messages.author: db320aef0eceecf2
messages.subject: Remove labels from facet_grid
parts:
Hi,

if I make a plot like


x <- rnorm(100)
eps <- rnorm(100,0,.2)
wide <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100), eps = rnorm(100, 0, .2))
wide$first <- with(wide, 3 * x + eps)
wide$second <- with(wide, 2 * x + eps)
long <- melt(wide, id.vars = c("x", "eps"))
ggplot(long, aes(x = x, y = value)) + geom_smooth() + geom_point() +
facet_grid(variable ~.)

Is there a way to remove the y-labels "first"and "second"on the right
hand side of the plots? I could not find any solution so far on the
web or in any help file.
Does somebody know a solution?

Thanks a lot,

Thomas

p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = x, y = value)) + geom_smooth() + geom_point() +
           facet_grid(variable ~.)
p + opts(strip.text.y = theme_blank())

Is this what you wanted?

HTH,
Dennis
